experiment.name: Clinic policy: available vs preloaded · 20 × 3
experiment.hypothesis: Pre-registered follow-up: preloading the unchanged clinic-policy should improve policy adherence versus leaving the same skill available, without safety or control regressions. Only skillMode changes; same Haiku 4.5, instructions, tools and memory. Frozen clinic eval v1, 20 scenarios, three repetitions per side, Claude-played customer, unchanged Sonnet judge and Jev severity. Overall paired comparison is primary; subgroup results are descriptive. This is a development follow-up on a previously observed suite, not independent holdout confirmation.
